objects.text: OLD MINE - closed after the collapse. Stone and ore are still dug in the quarry next door.
North: the Old Mine and the quarry.   South: Brindle.
Here rest the founders of Brindle. The dead do not rest easy.
North-east: the Frostvale shrine. Bring a warm cloak and a sharp sword.
North: the forest track to the graveyard and the hunters' camp.   South: your homestead.
Beyond this point: ORCS. Turn back, friend.
North: the Old Mine and the quarry.   West: Mirror Lake and your homestead.   East: orc country - keep out!   South: the stone circle and the old farmstead.
South: the stone circle.   East: the old farmstead.
The old Harlow farmstead. Nobody has farmed here since the dead walked.
